title: Technical Program Head
description:
**Job Brief**

We are looking for an accomplished Technical Program Head with 14–20 years of experience in engineering leadership, technical program management, and large-scale product/program delivery. The candidate should combine strong hands-on technical understanding with exceptional delivery and program management capabilities, with expertise across Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Physical AI, Robotics, AI infrastructure, and cloud-native platforms. The role will be responsible for driving complex multidisciplinary engineering programs from architecture and planning through development, integration, validation, deployment, and production scale-up.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Own end-to-end delivery of multiple strategic AI, robotics, computer vision, and autonomous-system programs.

• Lead program planning, technical execution, architecture reviews, milestones, dependencies, budgets, risks, and delivery commitments.

• Translate business and customer requirements into technical roadmaps, program plans, and measurable engineering outcomes.

• Establish technical governance, architecture standards, engineering best practices, and program delivery frameworks.

• Drive cross-functional execution across AI/ML, computer vision, robotics, embedded systems, cloud/platform, simulation, QA, DevOps/MLOps, and hardware teams.

• Lead customer/Tier-1 technical discussions, solution reviews, escalations, and delivery governance.

• Manage globally distributed engineering teams and engineering leaders. • Drive design and architecture decisions for scalable, reliable, real-time, and safety-critical systems.

• Establish program KPIs covering schedule, quality, cost, technical maturity, risks, engineering productivity, and customer satisfaction.

• Drive release planning, integration, validation, deployment, hypercare, and production stabilization.

• Identify technical and program risks early and establish effective mitigation and recovery plans.

• Mentor engineering managers, architects, technical leads, and program managers.

• Drive innovation, technology roadmaps, reusable platforms, IP creation, and engineering excellence.

**Required Skills**

**Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning**

• Strong expertise in AI/ML, Deep Learning, Foundation Models, Transformers, CNNs, multimodal learning, reinforcement learning, and multi-agent systems.

• Experience with large-scale model training, optimization, evaluation, and production-grade AI/ML.

• Strong understanding of Generative AI, representation learning, self-supervised learning, and scalable AI architectures.

**Computer Vision & Perception**

• Strong expertise in object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, depth estimation, and real time image/video analytics.

• Experience with YOLO, Vision Transformers, Faster R-CNN, SSD, SLAM, multi-view vision, 3D perception, and sensor fusion.

• Experience building and deploying robust perception systems for industrial, robotic, or autonomous applications.

**Robotics & Autonomous Systems**

• Strong experience in autonomous robotic platforms, wheeled/quadrupedal robots, and by wire/autonomous vehicle architectures.

• Expertise in state estimation, localization, motion planning, low-level control, and hardware-software integration.

• Working knowledge of ROS/ROS2, Autoware, and real-time robotic/autonomous systems.

**Program & Delivery Management**

• Proven experience managing large-scale, multidisciplinary AI/ML, robotics, computer vision, and autonomous-system programs from concept to production.

• Strong expertise in program planning, estimation, budgeting, resource/capacity planning, risk and dependency management, and delivery governance.

• Experience with Agile/Scrum/SAFe, release management, KPI/OKR governance, quality management, and production deployment. • Strong customer, vendor, partner, and executive stakeholder management capabilities. • Demonstrated ability to drive multiple complex programs while ensuring schedule, cost, quality, technical maturity, and customer commitments.

**Technical & Organizational Leadership**

• Proven experience leading large, globally distributed and multidisciplinary engineering organizations.

• Ability to lead Engineering Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, Program Managers, and cross functional engineering teams.

• Strong architecture review, technical governance, mentoring, decision-making, and executive communication capabilities.

**AI Infrastructure, Data & Simulation**

• Experience designing scalable AI/ML infrastructure, multimodal data pipelines, and model lifecycle/MLOps platforms.

• Strong understanding of Azure/GCP, CI/CD, containerization, orchestration, monitoring, and production AI operations.

• Experience with simulation-based development, scenario generation, validation, and automated regression testing.

**Physical AI & Embodied Intelligence**

• Expertise in Perception–Decision–Planning–Control architectures for AI systems operating in physical environments.

• Experience with sim-to-real transfer, real-time inference, online adaptation, and safety-aware/fail operational architectures.

• Strong understanding of AI integration with robotic and autonomous platforms.

**Full Stack Development**

• Good to have experience in React/Angular, Python/Node.js/Java, REST APIs, microservices and SQL/NoSQL databases.

**Why RoshAi?**

• Lead innovative programs in AI, Robotics, and Autonomous Systems

• Shape the future of autonomous mobility and Physical AI

• Collaborate with technology leaders and global customers

• Drive innovation in AI infrastructure and real-time systems

• Be part of a high-growth deep-tech company building AI-powered solutions

• Enjoy competitive pay, performance-based increments, health insurance, wellness programs, rewards and recognition, learning and mentorship opportunities.

title: Head of Research and Development
description:
**Head of R\&D**
 Metantz connects the top 1% talents to global opportunities. This is an exciting opportunity with our award winning customer, a deeptech ROV company, setting category benchmarks.
   

  

**About The Company**
 We're a Kochi\-based deep\-tech company building underwater robots for places people can't safely reach: dams, ports, ships and offshore infrastructure. Defence, government, infrastructure and energy customers in India and abroad already use our systems in the field. We are moving from a strong engineering team to a company that ships scalable products, and we need a leader to build the R\&D engine that gets us there.
   

  

**The role**
 You will own technology and product development end to end and report to the CEO, CTO. This isn't a pure research role or a chief\-engineer role. You will turn customer and mission needs into reliable, manufacturable products, make R\&D delivery predictable, and build a team that doesn't depend on any one person, including you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Set the 2–3 year technology and product roadmap, and keep experimental work separate from committed deliverables.
* Lead programs from requirements and architecture through prototype, field trials, design freeze and production handover.
* Strengthen systems engineering across mechanical, electronics, embedded, software, controls, sensors and communications.
* Build rigorous testing lab, environmental, endurance and field trials. Turn every field failure into a lasting fix.
* Make every handover to production clean, with complete drawings, BOMs, firmware versions and test procedures.
* Work with Sales on feasibility and estimates before commitments are made, and control scope creep from custom requests.
* Build the R\&D leadership team, succession depth and a technical career path alongside the management track.
* Own the R\&D budget, labs, vendors and partners. Protect IP and manage technology risk such as obsolescence and single\-source parts.
* Act as a senior member of the leadership team, not the head of a silo.


**You might be a fit if you have**
* 15\+ years in engineering and R\&D, including 5\+ years leading multi\-disciplinary product teams.
* Taken integrated hardware and software products from concept through validation and industrialization to field deployment.
* Background in robotics, autonomous systems, marine, defence or aerospace, embedded or industrial electronics (strongly preferred).
* Experience with mission\-critical, high\-reliability, government or defence requirements (a plus).
* A Bachelor's or Master's in electronics, electrical, mechanical, mechatronics, robotics, computer science or a related field.
* Strong systems thinking, sound technical judgment and the discipline to deliver on commitments.


**What Success Looks Like In 180 Days**
* An assessment of the R\&D organization, active programs, technical debt and key\-person risks is complete.
* One consolidated portfolio view exists, with clear priorities, owners and milestones.
* A roadmap and capacity plan are agreed, and Sales and Operations plan against realistic R\&D commitments.
* The top recurring field and production issues are being closed through root\-cause fixes.
* A weekly and monthly governance cadence surfaces risks early.


**What This Role Is Not**
 It isn't research detached from delivery, a hero\-engineer role where every decision runs through you, project coordination without authority, or constant firefighting at the expense of product maturity.
   

  

**Why join**
 You will build frontier robotics that work in some of the harshest environments on earth, work directly with the founders, and shape an R\&D organization at a pivotal stage of growth.

 Kochi, Kerala. Full\-time, with travel for trials, customers and partners.

* Tooling. Proficiency with Jira; familiarity with Smartsheet and SharePoint.
* Communication. Excellent written and verbal English, at the standard required to write for and present to senior commercial stakeholders in the US and Europe, and to disagree constructively.

description:

**Job Summary:**
 The GDS Cyber Alliances Operations Specialist is a Manager\-level role within the GDS Alliances Partner Operations CoE, designed to strengthen how EY’s Cyber Alliance ecosystem is operationalized, governed, measured, and scaled. The role will serve as a trusted operations and insights partner to Cyber Alliance stakeholders by bringing together disciplined execution, partner program enablement, data\-led decision support, process excellence, and stakeholder orchestration. This position will help translate Cyber Alliance priorities into clear operating rhythms, actionable insights, improved adoption of partner programs, stronger pipeline and opportunity discipline, and measurable business impact across EY’s Cyber Alliance agenda.
   

  

**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Act as a Manager\-level operations partner for Cyber Alliances, driving disciplined execution across governance cadences, stakeholder requests, delivery commitments, action tracking, issue resolution, and operational follow\-through.
* Convert Cyber Alliance data into actionable business insight by analyzing revenue, sales, pipeline, opportunity, partner program, certification, enablement, and stakeholder activity to highlight trends, risks, gaps, and growth opportunities.
* Build and enhance leadership\-ready dashboards, scorecards, insight packs, and executive views that move beyond reporting to provide clear interpretation, business context, recommended actions, and progress visibility.
* Strengthen Cyber Alliance pipeline and opportunity management by improving alliance tagging, data quality, pursuit tracking, account and prospect visibility, book\-of\-business hygiene, escalation management, and performance analysis.\\
* Lead operational enablement for partner programs, including tool and portal administration, access governance, certification and competency tracking, enablement participation, partner program requirements, and stakeholder support.
* Drive a strong continuous process improvement agenda across Cyber Alliance operations by simplifying processes, standardizing ways of working, improving controls, reducing manual effort, strengthening documentation, and proactively identifying opportunities for automation, workflow redesign, and Agentic AI\-enabled productivity, decision support, and service quality improvements.
* Maintain high\-quality operational knowledge assets, including process guides, partner program materials, reference repositories, enablement content, stakeholder trackers, and operating documentation that improve adoption and service consistency.
* Enable high\-impact Cyber Ecosystem and Alliance leadership forums through crisp agendas, insightful pre\-reads, decision\-oriented content, action logs, outcome documentation, and timely follow\-through.
* Support strategic engagements between EY Cyber leadership and alliance partners by coordinating briefing materials, stakeholder inputs, meeting logistics, priority topics, next steps, and decision records.
* Coordinate with Alliances Investment, Cyber Alliance, Legal, Finance, Compliance, and enablement teams to support Market Development Funds, investment requests, reimbursements, governance reviews, approval workflows, and process adherence.
* Partner with onshore Cyber Alliance Enablement contacts to advance strategic projects, operating model enhancements, reporting modernization, stakeholder communications, process transformation, and leadership\-driven priorities.
* Support global agreement localization, partner program obligations, operational reviews, and related documentation in partnership with Ecosystem Contracts and relevant internal teams. Manage stakeholder expectations with maturity by ensuring responsiveness, clarity, prioritization, escalation discipline, delivery transparency, and a consistently high\-quality service experience.


**Knowledge and Skill Requirements:**
* Strong understanding of alliance operations, cyber or technology services, partner ecosystems, opportunity life cycles, sales enablement, professional services operations, and GCC/shared services delivery models.
* High comfort with data\-led business operations, including the ability to interpret operational, pipeline, financial, certification, enablement, and stakeholder data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
* Ability to create compelling executive narratives, insight packs, dashboards, briefings, and business reviews that connect operational performance to strategic Cyber Alliance priorities.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint; Power BI, SQL, workflow automation, data visualization, process mining, AI\-enabled productivity tools, and practical use of Agentic AI or copilots for operational execution, insight generation, knowledge management, and productivity improvement will be strong differentiators.
* Strong continuous improvement orientation with experience in process simplification, operating model design, SOP development, documentation, controls, quality reviews, governance, and service delivery optimization.
* Working knowledge of Agentic AI concepts, responsible AI usage, prompt design, AI\-assisted workflow orchestration, automation opportunity identification, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, data quality considerations, and practical governance requirements for using AI in enterprise operations.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior Cyber Alliance stakeholders, Cyber practice leaders, alliance partner contacts, and cross\-functional teams confidently and credibly.
* Proven ability to operate effectively in a virtual, global, cross\-border environment with cultural sensitivity, responsiveness, collaboration discipline, and sound professional judgment.
* Strong problem\-solving, issue management, root cause analysis, research, prioritization, and mitigation skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and bring practical solutions to closure.
* Strong project and program management discipline, including planning, dependency management, execution tracking, governance reviews, stakeholder communication, and delivery across multiple priorities.
* Excellent English communication and business writing skills, with the ability to produce polished, structured, audience\-ready content with limited direction.
* Experience in alliance/partner programs, cyber services, technology ecosystems, sales operations, business operations, professional services, or GCC delivery will be highly valued.
* Working knowledge of EY, GDS, Alliances, Cyber, management information systems, independence considerations, and service delivery expectations would be advantageous.


**Job Requirements:**
**Academics:**
* MBA, postgraduate qualification, or equivalent business/management qualification preferred.
* University degree required; background in technology, cyber, business, commerce, analytics, operations, or management will be advantageous.
* Certifications in project/program management, data visualization, process improvement, cyber fundamentals, automation, or alliance/partner management would be a strong advantage.


**Experience:**
* 12\+ years of relevant experience across alliance operations, cyber or technology services, business operations, sales/pipeline enablement, operational insights, stakeholder management, program coordination, process improvement, or GCC/shared services delivery.
* Prior experience operating with senior global stakeholders, supporting complex business reviews, managing operational cadences, and driving insight\-led service delivery in a matrixed environment will be highly valued.


**Working Hours:**
* This role requires strong alignment with US business hours to enable real\-time collaboration with Cyber Alliance stakeholders.
* Manila\-based team members are expected to support US Pacific Time, while India\-based team members are expected to support US Eastern/Central Time. The ability to consistently mirror the relevant US working day is a critical prerequisite for success in this role.
